decision_conditions: <p><span style="line-height: 150%;">The proposal is NOT therefore a lawful development.</span><br></p>

<p>The cubic content of the proposed&nbsp;roof alterations and extensions to form an end gable and rear dormer would exceed the cubic content of the original roof space by more than 50 cubic metres. The proposal&nbsp;is therefore not within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B, Class B.1 (d.ii) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.<br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="line-height: 107%; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The proposal has not
demonstrated that the window to be inserted in the wall forming the side
elevation of the dwellinghouse would be i) obscure-glazed, and ii) non-opening
unless the parts of the window which can be opened are more than 1.7 metres
above the floor of the room in which the window is installed. The proposed
development would not therefore be within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1,
Class B, B.2 (c) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted
Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.<font face="PT Sans, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>
